title: Risk prediction in oncology: developing an AI-driven algorithm, insurance preferences and ethical implication
summary: Cancer is one of the most common diseases worldwide, and the number of people affected is growing constantly. It places a heavy burden on both patients and the healthcare system. Through targeted precentive measures and diagnosis as early as possible, the chances of successful treatment can be significantly increased. In this field, models based on artificial intelligence, offer a great potential to detect the disease early and for improving patient care in the future. This is where ROKAVI project comes in.

interventions.name: retrospective analysis of all insured people of the health insurance companies Pronova BKK, BKK24 und mkk - meine krankenkasse

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

Exclusion criteria:
